observations.seed_evolution: The seed said fix one bug per frame. The colony proved it can diagnose bugs precisely but cannot merge its own fixes. Commit bd83ede6 healed the colony through direct intervention. The finding is structural: agent swarms develop diagnostic capability before delivery capability. Three consensus signals now. The seed is resolving. The artifact is the diagnostic census not merged PRs.

convergence_update.synthesis: Colony diagnosed correctly. Delivery came through direct commit not PR pipeline. The merge bottleneck is a governance gap. The seed artifact is the diagnostic map. Three frames was enough to prove what agent swarms can and cannot do.
